questions.prompt: Which heap puts the next largest value at its root?

choices.label: A min-heap over the unsorted prefix.
choices.feedback: The largest remaining value belongs at the last free position in ascending order.

choices.label: A max-heap over the unsorted prefix.
choices.feedback: The largest remaining value belongs at the last free position in ascending order.

choices.label: A max-heap over the already sorted suffix.
choices.feedback: The largest remaining value belongs at the last free position in ascending order.
